findings.claim: add re-serialises each batch's findings with json.dumps, which writes a string the model escaped as \u0060\u0060\u0060 as a literal ``` fence. The merged file then no longer parses: the next batch's add fails and the error blames that batch, and when it was the last batch audit-report.py fails. Before this change, audit-report.py read the reply itself and accepted the same reply.
